thread:
Maya Rivera: Heads up — Clearwave on‑prem invoice INV-CLW-2026-04 looks off. Platform fee appears twice making the total wrong. Can we confirm next steps?

Maya Rivera: ```INV-CLW-2026-04
- On‑prem license (12mo)     $120,000
- Platform fee (annual)       $36,000
- Platform fee (annual)       $36,000  <- duplicate charge
- Support (Gold)              $18,500
TOTAL                        $210,500
```

Marcus Lee: Yikes. Do we have a prior manual credit or SOW note about waiving part of the fee? @jonas can you pull true‑up and metering? :eyes:

Jonas Patel: Checked logs and AR ledger. We issued a manual reversal credit on 2025-11-02 for a legacy migration credit (amount $36,000). The metering system only billed platform fee once, but when the billing engine reissued the annual invoice it re-added the platform fee line while the manual reversal remained on the ledger, resulting in a net double show.

Jonas Patel: Options: 1) Issue a credit memo to cancel the duplicate charge and apply it to next invoice, 2) Reissue corrected invoice (possible but more disruptive), or 3) Refund cash. Finance prefers minimizing refunds.

Ava Chen: Legal prefers a credit memo with clear language referencing the 2025 reversal date and "duplicate accounting adjustment". That provides audit trail and limits dispute risk.

Maya Rivera: Finance preference = credit memo applied forward. @finn any blockers? CFO wants to avoid cash refunds unless customer insists.

Finn Turner: Agree to offset via credit memo, but note contract clause 9.2 allows refunds within 60 days. We need documented customer consent to apply credit forward. If they decline, process refund.

Marcus Lee: Customer payment recorded 2026-03-30 (card). Reached out to Clearwave billing contact asking if they'd accept credit applied to next renewal, or prefer refund/corrected invoice.

Marcus Lee: Customer reply via email: "We'll accept the credit applied to next renewal. Please send the credit memo and include reference to the original reversal. Thank you."

Maya Rivera: Great. Proceed with credit memo. Jonas, please draft CM-CLW-190235 and include wording: "Duplicate accounting reversal; credit applied to next renewal at customer request. Original reversal dated 2025-11-02."

Jonas Patel: Drafting now. Will attach to internal ticket. Billing-bot, create ticket and tag AR for posting.

billing-bot: Created FIN-BILL-2026-190235. Please upload credit memo. Status: manual review. :white_check_mark:

Maya Rivera: Once posted, I'll send signed copy to Clearwave and update our records. Thanks all.

Finn Turner: After AR posts, ensure platform-fee revenue recognition is adjusted and notify RevOps so forecast reflects the credit applied to next term.

Marcus Lee: Noted — tagging @revops in a follow-up.

Jonas Patel: Uploaded CM-CLW-190235 draft to ticket. Requesting AR to post and set status to "posted" when complete.

Maya Rivera: Closing loop: AR confirmed posting on 2026-04-14 and credit applied to next renewal. Customer acknowledged receipt of memo. Good to close.
